Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add mode-aware region navigation behavior

Created NextRegionCursorOnly/PrevRegionCursorOnly actions that move
cursor without creating time selection.

Binding behavior by context:
- Normal mode (command): Cursor-only navigation (no time selection)
- Visual mode (visual_timeline_command): Navigate with selection
- Selector mode (timeline_selector): Navigate with selection

This gives Vim-like behavior: motions in normal mode don''t create
selections, but visual/selector modes do.

Also removed Shift+Arrow from timeline_motion (not in gwatcha/master
and had wrong syntax anyway).
